_comment: 2026-07-26 Act V (#270 beats 2-3): Pisces at the sealed rune-door, in the trapped halls. THE DOOR NEVER SPEAKS -- every option this beat needs lives on him. Beat 2's OR-parity is the `the_appetite` arm: #270 wants EITHER read to unlock beat 3, but only one counter can gate an option, so the rune-read player gets the ward fact from Pisces himself (he is the third producer of read_the_feeding_ward, alongside the door's own narration and the [Detect Magic] arm) and lands on the same choice. Beat 3's three forks are appended in Task 7.3.

at_the_door.speaker: Pisces
at_the_door.text: Do not touch it yet. I have waited a month to stand in front of this. Grant me the courtesy of a first impression.

text_variants.text: The same hand. I have now said so four times and it has not once stopped being remarkable. Ask me what it is for. Go on, ask.
A feeding ward. Under a city. Cut by whoever cut the frame you eat breakfast beside. I need a moment, and then I need a decision, and I would rather it were yours.

text_variants._comment: One arm per outcome, appended after the reading arms so last-match-wins leaves him standing in the ending the player chose. seal_kept_fed sits last on purpose: it is the only outcome another path can be layered on top of (a player who opened the seal and then could not finish the warden can still fund the keeper), and the fed line is the true state in that case.
text_variants.text: It is open, and it is quiet, and I have been standing in the doorway for an hour deciding whether that is a relief. Do not tell Ceria I said hour. Say minutes.
Your cut is holding. I have checked it eleven times, which you may read as distrust or as admiration; I decline to clarify.
A Watch keeper, a ledger line, and a ward that goes on eating on somebody's schedule. Civilization, apparently. I shall write about it and be insufferable.

options._comment: The OR-bridge: a player who only matched the hand (bare interact or [Observe]) hears the appetite from the man himself. Hidden once the fact is held, by whichever route landed it.

2026-07-26 Act V beat 3, THE CHOICE. One entry, three forks inside, so the decision is made in one place and reads as a decision. Gated on the ward fact (never on which Skill read it) and hidden once resolved.
options.text: So what do we do about a door that eats?

the_choice._comment: THREE REAL-COST PATHS (#270 beat 3), each with its own producer and its own fiction: FIGHT banks seal_opened here and resolves in the vault beyond the warden; TALK points at Olesm, whose own arm carries the Skill-or-gold cost and banks seal_kept_fed + seal_resolved; SKILL closes it here but only for a player holding BOTH a warding Skill and the guardian's fragment, which the arm CONSUMES. He argues for the second one, because he would.
the_choice.speaker: Pisces
the_choice.text: Three things, and I dislike two of them. We open it and see what three centuries of feeding produced. Or we leave it fed and make that somebody's paid duty, which is dull and correct. Or you re-cut the ward yourself, if you can, and it holds another age without anyone watching it.

options.text: It stays fed. The Watch can pay for it.

options._comment: SKILL fork, visible-locked (the witch pattern). TWO entry arms because #270 names both a warding Skill and a reading one, and requires cannot compound {skill, item} -- so the Skill gate opens the pitch and the ITEM gate closes it, one node down. That is the shipped multi-node persuade shape, not a gate stacked on a gate.
options.text: [Hedge Remedy] I can re-cut it. Properly.
[Detect Magic] I can re-cut it. I have read enough of these now.

fork_open._comment: seal_opened is banked on the OPTION, not here, so the door and the warden arm the instant the decision is made. He does not go with you into the fight: the ward re-seals the moment nobody is holding the reading open, and that is his job. It is also why the harness cell is SOLO.
fork_open.speaker: Pisces
fork_open.text: Then stand clear of it. The reading has to stay open while the seal comes apart, which means I am occupied and you are on your own for whatever objects to this. Something will. Wards this good are never the only precaution.

fork_fed.speaker: Pisces
fork_fed.text: Sensible. Deeply unsatisfying. It will need a real keeper, though, and a real ledger line, or it lapses in a decade and we are back here with worse knees. Olesm keeps the Watch's dread and the Watch's paperwork in the same drawer. Go and frighten him usefully.

options.text: I'll go and see him at the Guild.

fork_reward._comment: The item gate closes the fork. requires {item} HIDES when unmet, so the node text names the cost out loud -- guidance, not a progress leak. A player who traded the fragment to Hedault has spent this path, deliberately: the ruin drops exactly one, and the other two paths stay open.
fork_reward.speaker: Pisces
fork_reward.text: You would need warded stone to cut into, and not any warded stone. Something the same age, the same craft, and already carrying a working. The guardian we put down in the ruin was made of the stuff. If you kept the piece, this becomes a long afternoon and a permanent answer.

options.text: I have the fragment. Let's re-cut it.
Then it'll have to be another way.

fork_reward_done.speaker: Pisces
fork_reward_done.text: There. The pour runs the way it always did and now it runs through YOUR hand's work, which will outlast the city and annoy me for the rest of my life. Whatever is back there gets to keep sleeping. I have decided that is the outcome I wanted, and I will be saying so as though I said it first.

options.text: Let's get back up into the light.

the_appetite._comment: The MINIMUM read, deliberately plainer than the [Detect Magic] arm's quartet payoff -- the literate player gets the lattice, everyone gets the fact.
the_appetite.speaker: Pisces
the_appetite.text: It is not a lock. Nobody cuts a lock this generous. The lines run one way, they have run one way for a very long time, and that makes this a feeding ward. Something behind that stone has been drinking since before there were walls up there.

the_appetite_unknown.speaker: Pisces
the_appetite_unknown.text: I do not know. That is the entire problem and I want it written down that I said so first. A ward this careful was not built to imprison. It was built to KEEP something, the way you keep a fire, and someone chose to keep it fed rather than let it go out.

options.text: Then we decide what to do about it.
